summary: Phase 2 e2e validation. Backend pytest 16/16 passing including new TestNotes (add, ordering, empty rejection, cross-user 404), TestFollowUp (create + update persistence), and TestDashboardPhase2 (by_source counts and overdue_followups computation excluding Won/Lost). Frontend Playwright validated dashboard load, overdue banner ('2 leads have a follow-up due today or overdue.'), SourceInsights cards (LinkedIn/Website/Referral/Other all 1 = 25% each), follow-up cell styling (overdue=1 today=1 future=1), quick-contacted action (toast 'Marked as Contacted' + status badge updated), row click opens LeadDetailSheet, note creation via note-textarea + note-submit-button (note-{id} appears immediately in notes-list), LeadFormDialog popover date picker (35 day buttons rendered, picked date, trigger label switched to 'Apr 15, 2026', clear-followup-button became visible), and the existing CRUD/auth/logout flows still operate.
action_items: Optional: PUT /api/leads ignores explicit null on next_follow_up because update_data filters out None values; clearing follow-up via the LeadFormDialog 'Clear date' submit path will not erase server-side value (frontend works around via LeadDetailSheet 'detail-followup-clear' which sends null but it is also stripped). Consider switching to model_dump(exclude_unset=True) and treating an explicit null as a clear instruction.
Optional: POST /api/leads returns 200; conventionally should be 201.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_lead: `update_data = {k: v for k, v in payload.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` will silently drop legitimate clear-to-null requests for next_follow_up. Use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) and accept null explicitly.
Dashboard.jsx + LeadDetailSheet.jsx swallow API errors with empty catch blocks; surfacing toast on failure would aid users.
LeadFormDialog: when popover Calendar is open, clicking submit may require an outside click first; popover does not auto-close on select. Minor UX nit; consider closing popover after selection.
server.py: get_current_user accepts Bearer fallback even when Origin is browser; intentional for tests but verify production exposure is acceptable.
server.py: by_source aggregation only counts the four allowed sources; if a legacy doc has an unknown source it will be silently excluded (Pydantic Literal would already prevent it on insert).
test_credentials: MongoDB-seeded session per /app/auth_testing.md. Frontend used cookie session_token=test_session_fe_p2_1777100540771 on host prospect-manager-24.preview.emergentagent.com.
seed_data_creation: Created P2 Tester user in test_database with 4 leads: Overdue One (LinkedIn, follow-up -3d), Today One (Website, today, Contacted), Future One (Referral, +7d), No Date (Other, none). Pytest fixtures additionally provision TEST_user_A/B with cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_crm_backend.py (now 16 tests, classes: TestAuth, TestLeadsCrud, TestDashboard, TestIsolation, TestNotes, TestFollowUp, TestDashboardPhase2). For frontend, seed cookie session_token before navigating /dashboard. Calendar from react-day-picker v8 — use selector 'button[name="day"]:not([disabled])'. LeadDetailSheet right-side panel may push wide content off the 1920px viewport — call scroll_into_view_if_needed on note-submit-button. After picking a date in LeadFormDialog popover, explicitly press Escape or click outside before clicking lead-form-submit to avoid popover intercept.
rca of the issue: N/A - all Phase 2 acceptance criteria met.
